description: Phase 6 prototype - development_recommendations.json. THE atomic knowledge unit. Scoped (appliesTo) + condition table (conditions[]). One record = one source's table for a scope. Rows are INDEPENDENT combinations: exposureIndex + temperatureC + timeSeconds + agitationProfileId (agitation may differ per row). DF96 becomes ONE process-wide rule instead of two duplicated per-film entries (the exact smell the new model fixes). Rodinal times from current recipes.json; source classified as community (Massive Dev Chart) since no authority is recorded in the current data. HP5 EI 400 row = current data; EI 800 row = illustrative per plan example §2.6b. Pre-wet dropped (Q9).
